incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted LA/Orange private treatment payments, benefit retention, caregiver and access costs; clinical component is not whole portfolio.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Current FAQ describes individually assessed out-of-pocket costs and funding eligibility, but no actual payment amount, alternative payment baseline or current gift-attributable financial household cohort. Treatment and benefits/job-readiness mechanisms exist; absence of controlled research is not the reason for leaving resources unknown.
directions: Actual displaced private payments can create savings, while newly accessed treatment can increase outlays despite clinical benefit.

Fees, travel, time, childcare and caregiver losses apply to all funding-responsive accessed participants, independent of symptom response; no clinical eligibility multiplier automatically reduces these costs.
Benefits and employment pathways require taxes, benefit withdrawals, alternative jobs and work costs; no gross future wages or survivor earnings.
Public/grant funding and alternate providers remain baseline; payer savings, retail therapy value and repeated hotline contacts are not household cash.
